description: US business days calculator: counts working days between two dates (inclusive), excluding weekends and observed US federal holidays per 5 U.S.C. 6103 and OPM rules. Useful for deadlines, SLAs, shipping and payment due dates. Returns the count and lists the holidays skipped. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.01 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/calendar/us-business-days.
name: us_business_days
title: US federal business days
